_README: Central product database for The Tip Sheet. Article files never contain product URLs: they reference products by id, or products attach themselves to a look through matchedLooks.
LINK RULE: a card links to affiliateUrl when affiliateReady is true, otherwise to amazonUrl. Sample records never link.

SHOWN ON THE SITE: only records with verificationStatus 'verified' (a page we actually read confirmed the title and ASIN), plus 'sample' placeholders, which are labelled. 'needs-verification' records stay hidden.

TO VERIFY A RECORD: open candidateUrl in a browser, confirm title, shape, colour and that it is live, then copy candidateAsin to asin, set amazonUrl to https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>, set verificationStatus to 'verified' and lastChecked to today. Never guess an ASIN.

PHASE 2 (after Amazon Associates approval): paste the SiteStripe/PA-API link into affiliateUrl and set affiliateReady to true. No template changes are needed; the disclosure wording switches automatically.

IMAGES: image stays empty and imageUsageStatus 'pending' until a photo is authorised (brand/retailer permission or approved SiteStripe/PA-API image). Set imageUsageStatus 'approved' and image to a file in src/images only then. Never download, crop or AI-edit Amazon or customer-review photos.
No prices, ratings or reviews are stored here or shown on the site.
matchType: exact | close | alternative. verificationStatus: verified | needs-verification | sample. imageUsageStatus: none | pending | approved.
